page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a narrow column of marginal notes at the right, in small type, beside the lower paragraph. Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.l: accidat omnes homines in universum a rerum
æternarum amore & studio tandem sic de-
fecisse, ut res caducas in eorum locum in-
ordinate surrogatas totis affectibus prose-
quantur, tunc Diabolus cum infeernali sua
aula totius mundi princeps & Deus tyran-
nicus futurus sit, totius inferni mirabilia in
mundo cum omni iniquitate & abominatio-
ne patefacturus, donec verus Deus idemque
verus mundi Servator Iesus Christus, om-
nes impios e terra sic deleat, ut soli qui ad
eum toti convertentur, superstint ultimo:
unde subjecto diabolicæ potentiæ sublato,
voluntate scilicet hominis a Deo aversa, ma-
ligni spiritus nec locum hic nec accessum
amplius reperientes, sese hinc præcipites
proripiant in baratrum suum, ubi totius
universi corruptio cum impiis hominibus a
Deo segregabitur, illic potentiam regnum-
que suum tenebrosum, anxium, infelix,
omnis generis actibus, motibus, gesticula-
tionibus æternum exercituri.
XXII. Patebunt hæc atque similia evi-
dentissime quibusvis sacras Scripturas viis
a Deo præscriptis adeuntibus, quibus & de-
tegetur facile & abominationi erit summo-
pere hæc intellectus histrionici Scripturas
Hoc de subjecto enervandi methodus, in
dicto libro passim obvia. Scilicet quando cla-
rius Sole non modo loca occurrunt in Codi-
ce sacro veritatum suis præjudiciis errori-
busque adversantium declarativa, sed &
palpabilia facti experimenta narrantur, so-
let ægra & cæca ratio, in illis quidem pal-
pare.

page.notes: The side notes are set in very small type and run together; their exact wording is only partly legible, so the marginal note beside the second paragraph is a best reading. Marginal words: "Pravitas methodi qua is liber Scripturas cras ci adversantes, explicat & pervertit." Several words of the text are doubtful and not marked individually.
